text:
maria: Quick sync — proposing a staggered cutover for /v2 endpoints this Thursday 09:00 UTC. Plan: 4 slices across 4 hours (canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%). Owners: slice1 @aj, slice2 @sasha, slice3 @kevin, slice4 @maria. Need SDK 1.4.0 published by Wed 23:59 UTC. Any blockers?

aj: ACK owners. Can we shift each slice window +15m to give extra warm-up? still want the quick canary.

sasha: +1 on shift. Also we need the proxy header change (X-API-Version) in prod by Tue. PR #4821 is blocked on infra certs.

kevin: I'll take PR followups. Infra cert owner is @tanvi — can you confirm ETA on validation?

tanvi: Certs are provisioned, just running validation. ETA Tue 14:00 UTC. Will ping here when green.

maria: Good. SDK 1.4.0 blockers: changelog needs to call out the auth tweak (token scope change). @aj can you cut the release branch today?

aj: On it. Tagging branch release/v1.4.0, running staging smoke now. Will paste artifact link when ready.

release-bot: deploy started: staging-sdk-release-1.4.0 — logs: https://ci.company/builds/5532 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sasha: Also flag: legacy clients still call /v1/legacy-embed — we should keep a routing fallback for 48h after cutover. I added it to the runbook.

maria: Good catch. We'll implement automatic 302 -> /v1/compat for that path, with header `X-Routed-From: v2-cutover`. Ops to implement the redirect route.

kevin: Rollback plan (short): 1) revert routing table to pre-cutover, 2) scale canary to 0% and unroute new traffic, 3) revoke new cert if needed. Documented in runbook: https://docs.internal/cutovers/v2-rollout

aj: Smoke passed. SDK build artifact: https://ci.company/artifacts/sdk-1.4.0.tar.gz

tanvi: Cert validation done — infra green.

maria: Final asks: confirm the client library notify list and release notes by Wed EOD; marketing/legal already looped. I'll schedule a 30m post-cutover check-in. :calendar:

sasha: Pinged comms list and created the release note draft. :thumbsup:

kevin: I'll monitor latency/error-rate dashboards and set alerts (5xx > 0.5% or p95 latency +20%). Will post links to dashboards in the cutover channel.

maria: Thanks all. If no objections, we'll lock this in and proceed with the branch/release tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
